title: ID0412124-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / S8 170003980] Payment Terminal  Multiple billing issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Payment Terminal Multiple billing issue
The issue of multiple billing no longer arises, but VR Payment/CCV said that we had changed something that hadn't been coordinated, and that's why the multiple billing occurred.
-The receipt server at 170003980 with terminal ..66
is working, except for the time being out of date. Can we influence this, or is it CCV's issue? I'm not aware that we can influence it.
The receipt server at ..81 with terminal 65 isn't sending any receipts by email, and therefore no receipts can be found on the server. Together with CCV, the checkbox for sending receipts has been checked several times, but the terminal always loses this information.
I would argue that CCV has to provide an explanation for this. We have nothing to do with the payment receipt.
How do we actually deal with this, since we sold the CCV and may have to give it to CCV as well?
Root cause:
Solution:
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status:
Active
